summary: Copies the source string a2 into a fixed 32-byte buffer at obj+0x1B0, where obj is the target pointer held at this[0] (offset 0x0) plus 432. The copy is performed by sub_587DD0 with a max length of 31, followed by a forced null terminator at obj+0x1CF (+31). When a2 is null the copy is skipped and the first byte at obj+0x1B0 is zeroed instead (empty string). Returns the result of the copy helper on the non-null path and *this on the null path.

operations.description: Branch on a2 (source pointer) being non-null: non-null selects the copy path, null selects the zero-first-byte path.
Compute the destination as v3 = *this + 432, resolving through this[0] to the buffer at obj+0x1B0.
Copy up to 31 characters from a2 into the destination buffer via sub_587DD0.
Force a null terminator by writing 0 to the byte at v3 + 31, i.e. obj+0x1CF.
Null-source path: zero the first byte of the destination buffer at *this + 432 (obj+0x1B0) to make an empty string.
Return: the copy path returns sub_587DD0's result; the null path returns *this.
